verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's Entity Manager automatically displays registrations, statuses, and key data, and an interactive map shows each entity's registrations. Its annual-report and registered-agent surfaces add due dates, filing status, cross-state registration identification, and entity status monitoring. That covers entities, state registrations, standing, and deadlines, though only through vendor marketing claims. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that standing and upcoming deadlines appear together in one consolidated dashboard rather than across separate product surfaces, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
